name: OpenClaw NATS Channel
description: Bridge NATS subjects to the OpenClaw chat model. Inbound NATS messages are treated as prompts; LLM responses are published back to NATS.

nats.label: NATS
nats.description: Treat inbound NATS messages as prompts and publish LLM responses back to NATS.

token.description: Optional auth token presented to the NATS server. Omit (or set to empty) for servers that require no authentication.

subject.description: Subject (or wildcard, e.g. 'openclaw.prompt.>') to subscribe to.

subjectTemplate.description: Template for outbound subject. {tail} expands to wildcard capture from inbound subject; {subject} expands to the full inbound subject; {1}, {2}, ... expand to individual * captures.

hmacSecret.description: Shared secret for HMAC-SHA256 envelope signing. When omitted, inbound signatures are ignored and outbound envelopes are unsigned.

requireSignature.description: When true, reject inbound envelopes that are unsigned or have invalid signatures. Forced to false if hmacSecret is not configured.

maxClockSkewSeconds.description: Reject envelopes whose timestamp differs from now by more than this.

uiHints.label: NATS
uiHints.help: Bridge OpenClaw to a NATS message bus. Inbound messages are treated as prompts; LLM responses are published back.

token.label: NATS Token
token.help: Bearer token presented to the NATS server (sensitive).

security.hmacSecret.label: Envelope HMAC Secret
security.hmacSecret.help: Optional shared secret for signing/verifying envelopes (sensitive).
